subject.title: feat: add private AWS workspace service

question: Should Crabbox core permanently own this specialized route-scoped private AWS workspace service and its dedicated ECS deployment contract?
rationale: The PR creates a large new API, configuration, infrastructure, and operational surface beyond the established portable AWS lease path, and the visible discussion does not confirm long-term maintainer ownership of that direction.

options.title: Sponsor the core service
options.body: Accept the provider-owned dedicated AWS mode after the source defects, merge conflicts, and live security acceptance are resolved.

options.title: Keep only reusable primitives
options.body: Retain credential-chain and provider-capability improvements while moving the dedicated service deployment and operating contract outside core.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Leave the PR unmerged until maintainers define the intended dedicated-workspace product surface.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the core service
recommendation.body: Accept the provider-owned dedicated AWS mode after the source defects, merge conflicts, and live security acceptance are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history shows the strongest ownership signal for the existing AWS, fleet, Node runtime, and workspace API behavior.
